description: 14 nálezů z šestého kola hloubkového auditu (commit 2176b0e, 2026-11-08). Pokrývá: GPU lease lifecycle (C04), proof immutability a adopce úloh (C01, C05), pipeline stage contracts a confidence gate (C02, C03), preprocessing retry a schema validation (C06, C07), background GPU admission (C12), autotune vzorky (C08), automation souběžnost (C09), negative knowledge SQL limit (C10), PHP/C# export validator (C11), task search index startup (C13) a benchmark souběžnost (C14).

Execution recordy jsou immutable a jejich SHA256 výpočet se shoduje se čtečkou

acceptance_criteria: Critic failure v quality režimu nevrací degraded=False a success=True

acceptance_criteria: Active internal and external GPU operations retain exclusive fencing across lease TTLs
Inactive expired unknown outcomes recover automatically after bounded lease expiry
Opening an idle OpenCode bridge creates no GPU reservation
Confirmed terminal external requests release reservation immediately
No unrelated repository worktree changes are overwritten
task_c04_gpu_lease_lifecycle.description: Fix all GPU outcome-unknown and stale reservation causes. Keep active inference fenced with TTL-aware heartbeats; recover inactive expired uncertainty; avoid reserving GPU before external inference begins and release after confirmed terminal completion.
task_c04_gpu_lease_lifecycle.next_action: Review focused GPU diff and obtain runtime verification after current source-only checks.
task_c04_gpu_lease_lifecycle.title: P0-A: GPU lease lifecycle, unnecessary reservations, and stale outcome recovery
